description.value: Backeddy Resort & Marina is a remote waterfront resort on BC's Sunshine Coast near Egmont, built along 600 feet of shoreline on the Sechelt Inlet, with an oceanfront pub serving food and craft beer alongside a full-service marina. The pub features live music most weekends and an on-site fleet of mountain bike rentals for exploring the surrounding trails and Skookumchuk Narrows Provincial Park. Reached via the Langdale ferry and a scenic drive up Highway 101, it is a notable destination stop on the Sunshine Coast cycling route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at backeddy.ca was fully fetched and confirms this is a working oceanfront pub at an active resort near Egmont, BC on the Sunshine Coast. The amenities page explicitly lists a fleet of mountain bike rentals on-site, and the marina washhouse listing confirms on-site wash/toilet facilities for a full-service licensed pub. No explicit mention of bike racks, water refill, Wi-Fi, or takeout was found in the website text.
concerns: OSM name 'Backeddy Marine Pub' does not match website branding, which uses 'Backeddy Resort & Marina' for the overall property and 'Backeddy Pub' for the pub specifically; the word 'Marine' in the OSM name appears to be informal or outdated.
OSM record captures only the pub component of a full resort with accommodation, marina, and eco-tours; a broader or separate listing may be appropriate.
Address and phone are absent from OSM tags; values taken from website footer.
